name: Glacial Wood Products Inc
old_description: Everything we do is made-to-order. We manufacture world class wood components, so you can blow your clients away.
about:
Glacial Wood Products Inc was founded in 1991 in Brooten, Minnesota. The company is owned by Dan Soldner and operates with a team of skilled craftsmen that includes specialists in lathing, milling, CNC machining, drafting, and customer service.

The shop produces made-to-order wood components such as legs, posts, balusters, stair treads, newel posts, and custom square or turned parts. It also offers historical wood replication and custom woodwork from rough sketches. All drafting, machining, sanding, and inspection are performed in-house using CNC machinery, lathes, and milling equipment. The company states it can deliver runs ranging from a single piece to 10,000 pieces.

Glacial Wood serves cabinet makers, stair makers, furniture makers, interior designers, builders, architects, and other custom wood manufacturers. Named customers include Medalcraft Mint, Lake Shore Stair Company, and Greenfield Cabinetry.

The company emphasizes that it does not cut corners because its customers do not either. Its stated mission is to enhance the lives of its team and customers by delivering products that set the standard for craftsmanship, with no middlemen and no shortcuts between drafting and delivery.
